Name: Transmutation Time
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[i][b]Checking out [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23986]This Mod[/url] as an alternative![/b]

Have you ever had a dream that you could do anything?[/i] Including transmuting your bars back and forth? Well now you can do that part of your dream! I always thought it was weird that you could only transmute some things, so I introduce to you:
Transmutation Time! With this mod you can:

[b]- Transmute Gold Bars to Iridium Bars [Mining 9]
- Transmute Iridium Bars to (gasp) Radioactive Bars [Mining 10]
- DE transmute all bars in reverse
   - Radioactive Bars -> Iridium Bars [Mining 10]
   - Iridium  Bars -> Gold Bars [Mining 9]
   - Gold  Bars -> Iron Bars [Mining 9]
   - Iron  Bars -> Copper Bars [Mining 4][/b]

The file has config options just incase you want to change the difficulty (i.e making Radioactive Bars super expensive - or if you want to toggle radioactive bars all together.)
This config ALSO has the ability to change the recipes for transmuting Iron and Gold!

I really recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url] to configure your game, it has some descriptions that pop up for easier changing of your configs!

Kudos to these people for making mods that do similar things in the past (I made my own since I couldn't find one that did exactly what I wanted, and these ones are old and not maintained. I took NO code from them): 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5996]More Bar Transmutations[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1054]Reverse Transmutation By TheMegaCoolMan
[/url][b]
[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b] [/b]
